title: Buying a sofa
instructions: Bir çift mobilya mağazasında kanepe bakıyor. Renk, fiyat ve teslimata dikkat et.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hi. We're looking for a sofa for our living room.

script.speaker: a
script.text: This grey one is very popular. It's four hundred and fifty pounds.

script.speaker: b
script.text: It's nice, but our living room is quite small. Do you have a smaller one?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Yes, this blue one is smaller, and it's three hundred and twenty.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I like the colour. How long does delivery take?

script.speaker: a
script.text: About two weeks. Delivery is free if you spend more than three hundred.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Great. We'll take the blue one.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Perfect. Can I have your address?

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Emma buy the grey sofa?
options: Her living room is quite small.
questions.evidence: our living room is quite small.

questions.prompt: How much is the blue sofa?
questions.feedback: Mavi kanepe üç yüz yirmi pound.

options: They spend more than three hundred pounds.
questions.feedback: Üç yüz pounddan fazla harcayınca teslimat ücretsiz.
questions.evidence: Delivery is free if you spend more than three hundred.
